comparison_type: Complete specialized system versus general Pi on the same task and source material; not a causal ablation of any one module

shared.model: Same official DeepSeek model ID and API endpoint from one frozen settings snapshot
shared.model_settings: Identical main-Pi model, temperature, context window, maximum output/reasoning settings and shared aggregate budget. Specialized inner calls retain their stage-specific frozen inference policies; these are part of the system being compared and their settings/usage must be reported, not claimed identical to generic main-Pi calls.
shared.input_files: Identical original PDF excerpts and SHA
shared.raw_evidence: Same version of deterministic parser output: original page text, words/coordinates, tables, YAML/index and original PDF page images
shared.tools: Project-scoped source discovery, page/table reading, keyword retrieval, isolated Python with identical libraries, and artifact output
shared.task_and_output_contract: Same user task and machine-readable facts.json schema. Gold and evaluator-only table boundaries never enter either model context.
shared.isolation: Separate fresh projects; no specialized canonical database or previous conclusions supplied to the generic arm
shared.scoring: Same engine-neutral exact financial cell scorer. Source engine, directory/temporal/definition provenance and operational reliability scored separately.

generic_profile.system_prompt: You are a general-purpose assistant. Use the provided project tools to inspect sources, perform calculations and return the requested artifacts. Distinguish source evidence from inference.
generic_profile.exclusion_reason: These implement the specialized financial workflow being compared. Exclusion does not remove original evidence access or general computation.

execution.budget_scope: Shared across both sessions and all nested model calls within the arm
execution.first_run_policy: One first run per arm; preserve failed calls, cancellations and over-budget consumption. Do not tune one arm after reading this holdout outcome.
execution.freeze: Hash inputs, gold, protocol, runner/helpers, all production source and model configuration before and after each arm. If code differs, comparison not accepted.
